nodes.title: 1. チップ製造（8 秒）
widgets_values:
Photorealistic cinematic documentary style, clean cool lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth camera motion, no text, no logos.

Inside a semiconductor fab cleanroom bathed in amber lithography light.
[0s-3s] Overhead robotic arms carry a 300mm silicon wafer between machines, technicians in white bunny suits moving in the background.
[3s-6s] Macro shot: the wafer glides under an extreme-ultraviolet lithography scanner, a grid of identical large GPU dies appears across its mirror-like surface, rainbow diffraction shimmering.
[6s-8s] Slow push-in to an extreme close-up of a single GPU die on the wafer, intricate circuitry filling the frame.

Audio: low hum of cleanroom air handlers, soft mechanical whirs, subtle ambient electronic score, no voice.

nodes.title: 2. パッケージングと組み立て（8 秒）
widgets_values:
Continue seamlessly from the opening frame. Photorealistic cinematic documentary style, clean cool lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth camera motion, no text, no logos.

[0s-2s] The GPU die is cut free from the wafer by a diamond saw and lifted away by a vacuum pick-and-place head.
[2s-5s] On a packaging line the die is placed onto a silicon interposer next to stacks of high-bandwidth memory and bonded onto a green substrate; macro shots of tiny solder bumps reflowing.
[5s-8s] The finished GPU package is mounted on a large accelerator board under a heavy metal heat sink; the completed GPU module rests on an anti-static conveyor as the camera pulls back.

Audio: precise robotic clicks and servo motors, the same ambient electronic score continuing, no voice.

nodes.title: 3. サーバー構築（7 秒）
widgets_values:
Continue seamlessly from the opening frame. Photorealistic cinematic documentary style, bright clean factory lighting, smooth camera motion, no text, no logos.

[0s-3s] In a server assembly factory a technician in an anti-static smock lifts the GPU module and installs it into an open rack-mount server chassis beside seven identical GPU modules, fans and cables.
[3s-5s] The server lid closes and the chassis slides into a tall black server rack filled with identical servers.
[5s-7s] The fully populated rack, wrapped in protective film on a pallet, is wheeled up a ramp into a delivery truck.

Audio: power tools, rack rails sliding, footsteps, the ambient electronic score building, no voice.

nodes.title: 4. データセンター搬入（7 秒）
widgets_values:
Continue seamlessly from the opening frame. Photorealistic cinematic documentary style, smooth camera motion, no text, no logos.

[0s-2s] The delivery truck drives through the night and pulls up at the loading dock of a large modern data center.
[2s-5s] Workers roll the wrapped rack through a secure corridor into a cold aisle lined with rows of glowing server racks.
[5s-7s] The rack is locked into place, the film is pulled away and its status LEDs light up blue; final slow wide shot down the long data hall full of humming servers.

Audio: truck engine and air brakes, then the deep steady hum of the data hall, the ambient electronic score resolving, no voice.
